pmc-13461321: In this 2026 paper, privacy-preserving adaptive arrhythmia monitoring was achieved with wearable ECG, smartphone PPG, and federated on-device learning. The heart monitoring kept data local. The monitoring is the digital health advance.
arxiv-2606-16221: Tuning quantum circuits means searching a landscape full of traps — local minima where the optimizer gets stuck. QALM escapes them by interleaving exploration (trying new regions) with exploitation (refining good ones). The paper presents the optimizer for quantum computing researchers training variational circuits.
arxiv-2606-16621: Rotor drones with arm rigs face fickle air — gusts, load hops, shocks. This paper nests a live sky-gauge in the drill brain, re-reading the rig's mood each blink through doubt. For sky-rig crews who want sure grabs, come gusts or calm.
